latest.title: Local Topology of Riemannian Manifolds with Lower Intermediate Ricci Curvature Bounds
latest.abstract: We prove a vanishing theorem for the local Betti numbers of closed, $n$-dimensional Riemannian manifolds with a lower volume bound, an upper diameter bound, and a lower intermediate Ricci curvature bound. This generalizes and interpolates between known results under lower sectional and Ricci curvature bounds. Moreover, the methods extend to open manifolds, yielding a corresponding vanishing theorem for the global Betti numbers.
latest.workSummary: 在体积下界、直径上界及中间 Ricci 曲率下界下，证明闭流形局部 Betti 数消失并扩展到开流形情形。
latest.breakthrough: 在截面与 Ricci 下界已有结果之间建立插值。
latest.limitations: 应核对消失次数范围及尺度依赖；开流形结论有其独立假设。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。 局部 Betti 数指小球到整体流形的同调包含映射之像；不是断言小球自身所有高阶同调消失。
latest.priorityReason: 直接关联曲率下界、非塌缩与拓扑，适合优先分析具体估计。
